title: Richard Hicks appointed Aston Martin reserve driver
caption: Richard Hicks joins Aston Martin as reserve driver
body:
Aston Martin has confirmed the appointment of Australian driver Richard Hicks as its reserve driver. The role adds to the existing driver roster for the remainder of the season.

Richard Hicks races under number 24 and holds an Australian licence. He is currently under contract with Schubert Motorsport in the XGT series for the 2024 season. He has not yet recorded a race result in the league.

Aston Martin competes in the F1 series and sits third in the 2024 constructors' standings with 121 points. The team’s race line‑up includes Gunner Tai and Jacob Vavro, while junior drivers Gideon Lettink and Kaizer Navarro are also on the roster. So far the squad has achieved one win and two podium finishes under team principal Ethan Aston.
